The launch of watchOS 6 introduced the Always On state.
In watchOS 8, Always On expands to include your apps.
For example, when displaying dates and times, using values like , , and , the system automatically updates the view while in Always On.
Always On isn’t available on Apple Watch SE or Apple Watch Series 4 and earlier.
Apps compiled for watchOS 8 and later have Always On enabled by default.
Users can also disable Always On for the entire device or on a per-app basis by choosing Settings > Display & Brightness > Always On.
In watchOS 8 and later, apps can remain in the frontmost app state for a maximum of 1 hour.
However, you can use a to schedule periodic updates.
Because displayed information may be visible to casual observers, be sure to hide any sensitive data while your app is in Always On.
